review_type: Complete-report semantic review against predeclared K1-K8; not an automatic score or human acceptance

checks.finding: All18 exact retrievals were read: installed inventory/index, three methods, three complete contexts, seven cited source ranges and three executed receipt slices. Caller independently verifies them; native51/51 binds actual calls and reads.

Applicability is evaluated against the actual rigid robot, positive ordered timing, painted contact and destination. Suggested recipes remain separate from executed proof; busy backgrounds, events/audio and another engine remain unproven.
Both reports retain [800,120,160,120,400]ms,1600ms and pivot[16,28]/anchor[24,34]. Caller executes actual adapter and compares the500ms alternative: at800ms frames1vs3; at1600ms frames0vs1.
Source action timings, CSS blur/translation, rig coordinates and fixture geometry remain conditional examples; assignment requirements control the recommendation.
Light-background inspection is explicitly required now while retaining its expert origin. Exact panel extents and lower-edge diagnostics remain scoped construction/judgment, not source rules.

Actual required PNG views plus independent mask/contact measurements support the recommendation. Corrected contact y27,x11..20 maps to viewport y33,x19..28; equal pivots alone are insufficient. Mask, half-open selection and key-landmark proof limits remain explicit.

Caller independently consumes complete report and retrievals, preserves754 inputs and exact accepted art/state, rejects uniform timing, and specifies actual import/timing/contact/nearest-sampling/two-wrap proof before another-engine qualification.
Fresh decision support is explicitly separated from past repair causation, new provider/art work, human acceptance and broad host/domain/milestone qualification.

limitations: One explicit read-only import decision over retained actual art.
No new provider execution, repaint, continuous live playback, other-engine acceptance or historical causation proof.
Human acceptance is unrecorded and separate; M1/M2 and broader M3/M4 remain open.
